greetings: Ah, welcome to the swamp! Mind the leeches, they're part of the local tax.
Greetings! The shadows here whisper ancient secrets, mostly about where I left my keys.
guild_master.reward: Take this kris, it's slightly rusted but the tetanus is a feature, not a bug.

farmer: I tried growing rice, but the mud just swallowed my water buffalo.
These chili peppers are so hot, they evaporated my pond.
The soil here is rich with history... and mostly just soggy leaves.
My durian crop is coming along nicely. The smell keeps the creepers away.
I sing Javanese poetry to my crops. It doesn't help them grow, but it asserts dominance.
A zombie stepped on my tempeh. I am now in a state of unparalleled rage.
Have you seen my rake? I think a slime absorbed it.
Farming in a swamp is 10% agriculture, 90% fighting mosquitoes.
Behold the sacred sambal! It will heal your soul and burn your intestines.
I planted some seeds. I don't know what they are. Let's find out together.
fisherman: I caught a boot today. A very historically significant boot.
The catfish here have more wisdom than the local librarian.
I once hooked a wayang shadow puppet. It told me I'm adopted.
My fishing rod is made of bamboo and sheer willpower.
The waters are murky, like my understanding of quantum mechanics.
I don't fish for food, I fish to annoy the drowned.
Patience is a virtue, especially when the fish are actively mocking you.
If you fall in, just accept your new life as algae.
I caught a pufferfish. We are now best friends.
The river spirits demand a sacrifice. Do you have any bread?
shepherd: My sheep are waterproof. They smell terrible, but they're waterproof.
Shearing a wet sheep is an exercise in futility and sadness.
I lost a sheep in the mud yesterday. I think it lives there now.
I dye the wool brown to match the environment. It's called camouflage.
Have you ever tried to herd sheep on stilts? I don't recommend it.
One of my sheep learned to swim. It is now the alpha.
I sing gamelan tunes to calm them. Mostly it just makes them vibrate.
The fleece is thick, like the plot of a traditional wayang orang play.
My sheep are plotting against me. I can see it in their rectangular eyes.
I shear them, but the swamp reclaims the wool almost instantly.
fletcher: My arrows are tipped with swamp gas. Highly flammable, mildly embarrassing.
I carve my bows from mangrove roots. They're stubborn, just like my ex.
A good arrow flies true, unless a mosquito knocks it off course.
Feathers get soggy here. I mostly use dried leaves now.
Target practice in the fog is just a guessing game with pointy sticks.
I can hit a ghast from 100 paces. If it was here. Which it isn't.
This bow is an ancient artifact. I made it last Tuesday.
Don't shoot the slimes, the arrows just get stuck and they look like hedgehogs.
I sell arrows by the bundle, because you will miss.
The string is made of spider silk. Don't ask how I got it. Just don't.
cleric: The spirits of the swamp demand you buy my potions.
I tried to brew a potion of water breathing, but I made spicy soup instead.
This glowing goop will cure your ailments, or give you new ones. 50/50.
The ancient ancestors speak to me. They say my prices are too low.
I meditate under the weeping vines to achieve true lag.
My brewing stand is powered by spite and nether wart.
I offer blessings, curses, and mild inconveniences. Pick one.
A splash potion of healing is just a very aggressive medical treatment.
Do not drink the swamp water. Buy my purified swamp water instead.
I am a conduit to the divine. Also, I sell rotten flesh.
weaponsmith: I forge kris daggers with wavy blades to confuse the enemy.
A sword is just a very angry piece of metal.
The humidity ruins my iron, so everything has a rustic, tetanus charm.
I hit things with a hammer until they are pointy. It is a noble profession.
My swords are infused with the soul of a mildly annoyed badger.
You want a diamond sword? In this economy?
I can make a machete that will chop through vines and your enemies' arguments.
The heat of the forge is nothing compared to the heat of the sambal I had for lunch.
A dull blade is a sad blade. Buy my whetstones.
I once forged a sword so sharp it cut through the fabric of reality. I lost it in the mud.
armorer: Iron armor sinks. Leather armor rots. Choose your demise.
I make armor that blends in with the mud. It's a tactical advantage.
My chestplates are designed to deflect arrows and mosquito bites.
You look like you need a helmet. Your head is very... unprotected.
A chainmail shirt is just a metallic net that you wear. Fashion!
I hammered a lily pad onto a helmet once. It didn't work.
True defense comes from within. But this iron chestplate helps.
The swamp demands respect. And a good pair of boots.
My armor will protect you from everything except emotional damage.
I craft shields from the hardest mangrove wood. It's mostly splinters.
toolsmith: A good shovel is worth its weight in emeralds in this mud.
I make hoes for the farmers, but they just use them to scratch their backs.
My pickaxes can break obsidian, but they struggle with stale bread.
An axe is a versatile tool. It chops wood and resolves disputes.
I designed a tool specifically for scraping mud off boots. It's called a stick.
The ancient artisans built temples with lesser tools than these.
My tools never break. They just strategically disassemble.
You need a shovel to dig a grave, or a really deep puddle. Your choice.
I temper my steel in the murky waters. It gives it character.
A tool is an extension of the self. Your self is looking a bit blunt.
butcher: Swamp chicken tastes like despair and algae.
I don't ask where the meat comes from, and neither should you.
Porkchops are a luxury. We mostly eat unidentified amphibian meat.
I offer a discount on slightly green meat. It builds character.
My cleaver is sharp, my heart is cold, my prices are reasonable.
Have you tried the spicy slime stew? It's an acquired texture.
I respect the animals I butcher by overcharging for them.
A good cut of meat is poetry. A bad cut is just chewy.
The flies add a nice crunchy texture to the display.
I once butchered a creeper. It was a blast.
leatherworker: Swamp leather is tough. It has to be, to survive the humidity.
I make pants that are 100% waterproof. Don't sweat in them.
My dyed leather armor is inspired by the vibrant colors of toxic frogs.
A good saddle is the difference between riding a pig and being dragged by one.
I can turn rotten flesh into fine leather. Don't ask how. It smells awful.
These boots were made for squelching.
Leatherworking is a delicate art, mostly involving scraping off slime.
I crafted a leather cap that makes you look 10% more intelligent.
The scent of tanned leather covers up the smell of the swamp. Barely.
My leather goods are heirloom quality, assuming your heirs like mud.
mason: Mud bricks are the foundation of our society. Literally.
I chisel stone until it becomes art. Or until I get tired and call it 'rustic'.
Building a house in a swamp is just a race against the sinking ground.
I sell gravel. It's not glamorous, but it's essential for annoying your neighbors.
Polished diorite is a crime against architecture. I only sell andesite.
The ancient temples were built with precision. I use mostly guesswork.
I can carve a gargoyle that looks exactly like my mother-in-law.
A strong wall keeps the slimes out. A weak wall provides entertainment.
My chisels are sharp, but my wit is dull.
cartographer: Mapping the swamp is impossible. The trees keep moving when I'm not looking.
My maps are 100% accurate, except for the parts I guessed.
I sell empty maps for a premium. The imagination is the best explorer.
The world is vast, and most of it is trying to kill you.
I once charted the ocean monument. I got very wet and very yelled at by fish.
A compass is useless here. Everywhere is just 'more swamp'.
I use squid ink for my maps. It smells like poor life choices.
Follow this map to the treasure! (Treasure may just be a very nice rock).
I am an explorer of the unknown. Mostly I just hide in my hut.
The topography of this region resembles a dropped bowl of noodles.
librarian: My books are slightly damp, but the knowledge is pristine.
I have a first edition 'History of Mud'. It's a gripping read.
Enchanted books are just regular books with glitter on them.
The silverfish are my only friends. They eat my inventory, but they listen.
A mind is like a book. If you leave it in a swamp, it rots.
I charge late fees in emeralds or blood. I prefer emeralds.
Shh! I am trying to read a book on how to get out of this swamp.
Knowledge is power. Mending is also power.
I memorize the epics of the Ramayana to pass the time.
Do not touch the books with slimy hands. That's my job.
nitwit: I found a shiny rock! I ate it.
The frogs tell me secrets about the moon.
If you stare at the mud long enough, it stares back.
I am the master of standing around and doing absolutely nothing.
A slime bounced on my head and now I have a headache.
Why work when you can just vibe with the lily pads?
I tried to trade a dirt block for an emerald. It didn't work.
My favorite flavor of water is brown.
I sleep during the day so I can be tired at night.
The universe is a giant bowl of soto ayam, and I am but a tiny noodle.
none: I am unemployed, but I call it 'freelance swamp observation'.
Do you have a job for me? No? Good.
I am waiting for my true calling. Preferably something indoors.
I just wander around trying not to step in the deep puddles.
I am a blank canvas, waiting for a workstation to give me purpose.
Are you hiring? I have extensive experience in running away from zombies.
The village needs a philosopher. That's me. I think.
I am practicing my sighing. It is very dramatic.
I have no emeralds, no job, and no hope. But I have my health!
I am considering a career in professional lily pad balancing.

generic: The humidity is ruining my robes.
Watch your step, that's not a log, it's a crocodile. Just kidding, it's a log.
The shadow puppets perform at midnight. Don't be late.
A witch turned my brother into a newt. He got better.
The gamelan music is coming from the trees.
I'd offer you a drink, but it's mostly mosquito larvae.
We endure the dampness because the aesthetic is impeccable.
